releaseNotes: Fixes a rare crash that could take the app down while the home screen was rebuilding its Continue Watching rows. A lock on a whole folder now hides its titles on the home screen straight after launch instead of only on the next visit, and locking a show from a Continue Watching card works even for older entries. Searching inside the player's Episodes list now matches what the row actually says - typing episode used to find nothing when the provider left the title blank - and you can jump straight to one with s01e03. Update from Settings - Check for Updates.
